sbom_schemas.validation: jsonschema 4.x validate against the published schemas in the report job

licence_record.reused: tools/check_reading_licenses.py (COMPONENTS) and the shared stage check

static_dependency.method: ar t / lib /list members, nm / dumpbin /symbols symbol sets, undefined-to-defined intersection, and the real Ninja link command of the installed-API probe
static_dependency.foreign_library_copies_note: lib/libaom, lib/libsharpyuv, lib/libwebp, lib/libwebpdecoder, lib/libwebpdemux, lib/libwebpmux installed under their upstream names next to lib/exreader/libexr_vendor_*

exclusions_verified.audio_and_gpl_options: EXR_ENABLE_AUDIO, EXR_ENABLE_MP3, EXR_ENABLE_AAC all OFF; no audio layer, archive or licence in any install
exclusions_verified.webview: no web engine file, exported target or native dependency
exclusions_verified.test_credentials: no credential module target or material
exclusions_verified.build_machine_paths: none in either generated SBOM; 9/9/29/31/9/9 installed files still carry one

release_blockers.owner: root: the files are a shared document, the fetched projects' install rules and the protected build configuration

not_covered: Android, iOS and Apple native host packaging: separate owners, not built or packed here
GTK/Linux, Windows and macOS native host bundles and their Noto Sans CJK host font
Audio builds: EXR_ENABLE_AUDIO and the MP3/AAC codecs are excluded from the reading presets
PDF editing, text index, shared compatibility library, JNI bindings, tools and test binaries
Offline installer, code signing, notarization, tag, Release and store publication
Legal review: the registered licence identifiers are inventoried, not adjudicated

original_failures.reason: protocol: first-party LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md copies were compared as license-directory material
protocol: the per-component existence check still looked only at license-directory material
protocol: five fixtures mutated the install without keeping a file record, and SBOM structures were reported without reasons
protocol: the dumpbin dependency block ended on its blank separator line
protocol: COFF section symbols were parsed as linkable symbols
installs: the probe never prepended the install prefix; the Windows compiler environment used an unbraced env form
installs: identity, notice scope and symbol precedence defects in this package's own checks
one install: the layout listing closed the pipeline early under pipefail; five other installs were green
superseded: accepted=true on all six installs before upstream-named library copies were recorded
installs: the archive scan unpacked four lists but initialised three
